historical_references.reference: Rukmagandas was a Jain monk and an eminent scholar of the 15th century. He contributed significantly to the Jain literature, particularly in the fields of logic, metaphysics, and epistemology.

Rukmagandas was also a Hindu king who ruled over the Gangavadi region in the late 13th century. He was a powerful king who extended his rule over the neighboring regions and was known for his military prowess and just rule.

In modern times, this name has gained popularity across various platforms. For instance, in TV shows and films, it has been referenced in Indian series like 'Mahabharat' and 'Chakravartin Ashoka Samrat'. On social media, it's often used as a unique and meaningful name for character creation in role-playing games or as a topic of discussion in Hindu mythology-related communities. In gaming, Rukmangada has been featured as a character in games like 'Gods of Boom' and 'War of the Vishnu'. These trends reflect the enduring influence of Hindu mythology and the ongoing interest in Indian culture and history.
